description: Source code for AMR audio extractor in Android, including class definitions for AMRSource and functions for parsing AMR frames, sniffing AMR headers, and exporting extractor interface.

classes.name: AMRSource
classes.description: Media track helper class for reading AMR frames from data source.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates size of an AMR frame based on frame type and wide/narrow band.

methods.name: getFrameSizeByOffset
methods.description: Reads header byte at given offset to determine frame size.

methods.name: SniffAMR
methods.description: Checks if data source contains AMR or AMR-WB header, sets isWide accordingly.

methods.name: AMRExtractor::AMRExtractor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes extractor, sniffs data, and sets metadata.

methods.name: AMRExtractor::getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata about the AMR stream.

methods.name: AMRExtractor::countTracks
methods.description: Returns number of tracks (1 if initialized).

methods.name: AMRExtractor::getTrack
methods.description: Returns the track helper for the first track.

methods.name: AMRSource::start
methods.description: Starts reading from the data source.

methods.name: AMRSource::stop
methods.description: Stops reading from the data source.

methods.name: AMRSource::read
methods.description: Reads next AMR frame into buffer, updates timestamp.
